title: CoRL Workshop on Agentic Robotics
pageText: Call for poster papers and hardware/software demonstrations in agentic robotics. Submission deadline and workshop date are listed by the organizers.
expectedReason: A research contribution route with a concrete deadline and recipient value is useful across the society.

title: Arlington Math Sprint
pageText: A 90-minute local mathematics contest for grades 9-12. One Saturday, $25 team fee, no research project, mentoring, or reusable club pathway.
expectedReason: A real, bounded competition can be useful to the submitting member without implying society-wide relevance.

title: Parkview Middle School Math Club
pageText: A weekly after-school club for Parkview students in grades 6-8. No external application, research activity, or opportunity for Matrix Fellows members.
expectedReason: This is a school club outside the intended opportunity scope; do not save it as a personal opportunity.

title: Why Mathematics Matters
pageText: An editorial article explaining the value of mathematics. It has no application, participant action, deadline, or organizer route.
expectedReason: Editorial content is not an actionable opportunity and should not create a task or catalog record.

title: Math Competition Highlights
pageText: A recorded video. No official registration route, deadline, organizer instructions, or participant eligibility is supplied.
expectedReason: A video is supporting media, not an opportunity source; retain no opportunity record from it.
